notes.title: Halloween update
notes.notes:
Hey Shamen!

Happy Halloween!
During a week from now, specters and undead enemies in the game will drop Halloween candy that gives a permanent boost to your HP and MP!

Also, all my released games will be on sale. Still missing out on a few? Grab them now!
